question: What merit is gained at every step by carrying the goddess on the shoulder?
premises: A person carries the goddess on the shoulder
The aśvamedha sacrifice is the standard of comparison
inference: One who carries the goddess on the shoulder gains the merit of an aśvamedha at every step.
uncertainties: The verb for gaining merit is implied from context rather than stated
plain_english: But whoever carries the goddess on his shoulder gains the merit of an aśvamedha at every step.
